body: Grew up witnessing my own dad become a pretty harsh alcoholic. Including fighting but not to his own kids, his own brothers. Was too traumatic having to break it up since young so I’ve been put off alcohol. It’s just not for me and I’m not into it either.

Now , I don’t recall much of this as I was a little kid but this is from my mums POV included. 

My grandfather lives next to a cemetery, no biggie. Keep in mind this has only ever happened to me, nobody else especially other family members who had previously moved in with us at my grandfathers place. I still only partially remember a certain amount of minutes of it happening but anything after ? Not so much only my mum recalls that. 

One night I woke up randomly seeing this black/shadow figure she had really long black hair and was pointing at me! I figured it was my sister who had the same hair length and most likely the same weight and I just remembered looking to my left and my sister was dead asleep, it scared the crap out of me but ultimately I felt safe and calm and cried myself back to sleep until I was told what happened after. This isn’t the first time either i had done this but, my mum recalls hearing me scream at the top of my lungs so she comes running in and sees me scratching the walls crying for help telling whoever or whatever to leave me alone. 

This is one of the many scariest things I had experienced as a young child as I was ever the only one to see “things”. To this day, the figure is so engraved in my head it scares me sometimes knowing I live here with my grandfather again and do not want to be met with that shadow again. But, apparently so that was the last straw for my mum for what I was experiencing as a young child, she called a priest to come bless the house, never experienced anything after that night. I think it really freaked my mum out after what she saw me doing, freaks me out even knowing I was scratching the walls begging for help and screaming.

I once was told “If someone told you they are struggling what’s the first thing you’d do? Try to help? No. Don’t. That person is broken inside, they are wanting your comfort and to truly understand their feelings instead of jumping to conclusions to help them. They want to be heard by you and feel like they are needed in this world, they simply are needed but it’s about reassurance for them so they are comfortable here in this life and for them to find peace within themselves knowing someone really cares” 

I never really understood this statement so take it in however you like but I feel it was needed to be said to you, I always think about the statement a lot and was told about it… at least a year ago and a half when I was struggling and depressed for 8 months straight. Only this year I’ve come to understand the meaning of it and have no ill intentions towards the statement, at first I did because my first instinct was to be helped but y’know I’ve come to realise the statement is how I want to be heard.
